first_words: The owner would beat his goat with sticks
trying to make it aggressive toward people
And this went on for a long time
But one day, the goat had enough
It charged forward and rammed its sharp horns
As he stumbled away, the goat chased him onto the porch
He hit the ground hard and died within minutes
When his body was found, the goat was captured
But instead of being put down, it was taken in by animal rescuers
